physicalChanges.canonicalResolution: Exact canonical asset identifier takes precedence; an alias is accepted only when it maps to exactly one canonical history.
physicalChanges.ambiguousAlias: Returns no history and never merges events from multiple canonical assets.
physicalChanges.publicNonEnumeration: Unknown, ambiguous and private-only histories normalize to the same customer-safe empty projection.
physicalChanges.eventIntegrity: eventId is recomputed and cross-bound to canonical asset, timestamps, score, methodology, evidence and source metadata.
physicalChanges.durability: Read-only RPC success cannot promote durable write/readback status.
physicalChanges.sharedReader: Shield, Angel, reports and other consumers inherit the v2 canonical reader rather than the legacy canonical_id OR alias RPC.
physicalChanges.costBoundary: Public history is limited to 144 events and a bounded rate limiter; internal service-role history remains separately bounded to 5000.

truthBoundary: No-socket local/runtime/static/source proof only. It does not prove deployed HTTP timing indistinguishability, PostgreSQL migration execution, RLS, Browser accessibility, staging, production or real customer data.
